sentences.text: Western Australia’s outgoing Corruption and Crime Commissioner reviewed the Commission’s administration over the preceding decade to guide the new Joint Standing Committee.
sentences.section: The reason for this report on an administrative matter
sentences.support:
The purpose of this policy Report is to give an account of the administration of the 
Commission over the past decade

sentences.text: The report explains misconduct assessment, oversight of agency investigations and the Commission’s own investigations.
sentences.section: How Reports to the Commission are Dealt With
sentences.support:
The Commission receives information about suspected misconduct in 
various ways.

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that the Corruption, Crime and Misconduct Act was no longer fully suited to its purpose and needed replacement.
sentences.support:
The Corruption, Crime and Misconduct Act is no longer completely fit for 
purpose.

sentences.text: The Commissioner made three recommendations addressing organised-crime powers, a broader definition of public officer and replacement legislation.
sentences.support:
It is timely to re-examine the exceptional powers Part of the Corruption, 
Crime and Misconduct Act

notes: The foreword is autobiographical rather than a summary; no separate executive summary or equivalent synopsis is provided. Findings are omitted because OPAX already lists a finding.
